admitted_event: receipt_status==1 and value>0 and to_address matches 0x[0-9a-f]{40}
duplicates: reject day on duplicate transaction hash

paper_scale.rule: induced subgraph on K most active addresses; activity=in_count+out_count of admitted transactions; ties lexicographic address
paper_scale.calibration: K chosen label-free on weeks 2022-03-07, 2022-09-05, 2023-03-06, 2023-09-04 to match paper density 0.003 in log space; cap 50000
